ANNA UNIVERSITY, CHENNAI – 600 025B.E. / B.Tech. Degree Examinations
MA 3351 · VECTOR CALCULUS · Time: 3 Hrs · Max: 100
PART A (10 × 2 = 20) 1. Find ∇φ if φ = x²y + yz².
2. Define a solenoidal vector field.
3. Evaluate curl(r̄), r̄ = xî + yĵ + zk̂.
4. State Green’s theorem.
5. Find the directional derivative of φ = xyz at (1,1,1).
PART B (5 × 16 = 80) 6. Verify Gauss divergence theorem for F = x²î + y²ĵ + z²k̂ over the unit cube.
7. Evaluate ∮C (x²−y)dx + (x+y²)dy using Stokes’ theorem.
8. Show that F = (y²cos x+z³)î + (2y sin x−4)ĵ + (3xz²+2)k̂ is conservative.
